wireContract: Spec 015 §5.2a participant claim. Adds POST /rewards/credits/{creditId}/claim, which claims one of the signed-in user's Megapot participant credits and returns the outcome (accepted, subject_conflict, verification_missing, verification_stale, verification_failed, not_claimable) with the credit; an absent or foreign credit is 404. Every reward credit gains claim, null for credits that need no claim, with status unclaimed, accepted or subject_conflict and, once accepted, payout_status pending, recipient_pending, submitted, confirmed or failed_retrying.
